name: 511 Transit Incentives
description: Free $25 Clipper card for pledging to try transit
fullDescription: 511 CCTA's Try Transit program encourages commuters and college students in Contra Costa County to try public transit instead of driving alone, providing a Clipper card preloaded with $25.
whatTheyOffer:
- Free Clipper card preloaded with $25 when you pledge to try transit
- Separate offers for commuters and college students
- Some West Contra Costa commuters with a 19-digit Clipper account can get $25 added to their existing account
- Can be used on any transit agency that accepts Clipper
howToGetIt:
1. Commuters: live or work in Contra Costa County, be 18+, and otherwise drive alone to work
2. Students: attend an eligible Contra Costa college or adult school (such as DVC, Contra Costa College, Los Medanos, Saint Mary's, or CSU East Bay Concord) with at least 9 units, and otherwise drive alone
3. Apply online and agree to complete a brief survey
4. Receive your $25 Clipper card by mail
5. Limit one 511 CCTA incentive per household per July-June funding year
keywords: 511, transit incentive, Contra Costa, free Clipper, $25, pledge, commuter, bus, train, public transit
